description: Use when a buyer agent is about to pay an x402 seller it hasn't paid before, or above its usual amount: a signed verdict from what Agoranome holds: the Fair Offer block and certification, the pay-to and since when, OFAC sanctions on it, Google Web Risk on the URL, price against listing and quote, verified deliveries, policy tiers met. Give url= up to 20 times to rank sellers safest first. With tx=, settlement proof after paying: the USDC transfer on Base and whether it matched the quote. Price: $0.01 in USDC per call, paid with x402 inside the tool call. Or send a Skyfire pay or kya-pay token in the kyapay-token header (or in this tool's kyapay-token argument), and this tool charges $0.01 to it. Failed calls aren't charged.
